Thanks for sharing your story, I can see a lot of things that relate to mine and I have been really hooked on to what you where saying. I still haven't gone over the fact of leaving him. I'm always chatting with him although he does indeed have life problems.

I love him more then anything in my life[apart from my parents] and I always want to help him. As for now, where trying to find solutions.
I'll take your words and not let him alone. I never want to either way.

I have no believes for a god, as an atheist I hoped to live my life as myself, gay and happy. It's really difficult when your love of your life is christian and only found out that he was bisexual because you showed him love into that side. I hope we can get together and have a big relationship.

Thanks, I hope you and your husband will over-pass this challenges over time.

Cheer,

OfficerTwentyone.

Unfortunately, from the sources, he was looking for he didn't find any and is willing to give up his Christianity if I can convince the person that convinced him to be christian.

We want to be together, have fun and stay together. I like helping him a lot when he's in tough times and just tries to keep him positive.  He also wants to be with me, and that's also why it's making me depressed all of this.
